content.summary: Both of my round-one required revisions are satisfied. The new literal models, trace conventions and neighbourhood notation agree with the inspected sources; the obligation map now gives usable routes from the compressed main proof to ordinary bridges, finite evidence and completion records. No further exposition revision is required by this source-map review. Continue the remaining scientific review; this is not acceptance of all finite predicates or final publication.

findings.statement: Section 3 now defines the literal P10 and R16 models, high-degree separated sums versus permitted lower-degree leaf sharing, exact singleton classes, residual cardinality and hub traces, N[max], and the cyclic Andrasfai indexing convention.
findings.disposition: These additions supply the definitions requested in round one. They match the pinned prior's canonical and high-link sections and the two local R16-deletion proofs inspected in this round.

findings.statement: The final companion table and detailed definitions-and-map.md now identify the low-degree support argument, three tree domains, rho=7 classification, both deletion contradictions, D16 bridges, and cap15 graph/cover obligations.
findings.disposition: The map states conclusions and separates written arguments from finite checks. It also explains why dated pending-status text does not replace later completion receipts and explicitly identifies the direct-Jin replacement. The map is adequate for the requested exposition repair.

findings.statement: The new source map preserves ordinary computer-assisted assurance and does not promote imported classifications, stored PASS receipts, or separately written checks into Lean proofs or independent human certification.
findings.disposition: Retain this distinction in later versions. This round checked selected mathematical statements and source routing, not every checker implementation or receipt.

revisions.action: Inspected the expanded Section 3 definitions against the pinned prior main.tex canonical/R16/high-link sections and the outer- and hub-deletion proof notes.
revisions.result: All requested structural and counting definitions are now present, including the distinction between complete-family anchor counts and residual hub counts. The new N[max] definition makes the graph minimum-degree deductions readable.

revisions.action: Followed the new obligation map to the degree-two ordinary check, support reduction, finite-tree assembly, D16 fibre preparation and cap15 cover bridge; compared their conclusions with the table.
revisions.result: The map supplies specific files and sections for the requested obligations and distinguishes imported, ordinary and executable components. The detailed map also provides the degree-one locator omitted from the short main-text summary.

checks.scope: Literal P10 and R16 definitions and component conventions
checks.method: Compared manuscript Section 3 with frozen prior paper/main.tex lines 206-226, 443-462 and 612-635; directly expanded the two finite models using a short Python standard-library check.
checks.observation: The P10 list matches the pinned source and has 10 distinct triples, degree 5 at all six points, pair codegree 2, and no three-sunflower. The R16 construction has 16 distinct triples on ten points, no three-sunflower, and maximum disjoint count 7. The prior high-link lemma explicitly states disjoint supports for degrees 17-20, matching the revised convention. These checks verify the displayed representatives, not the classification theorem.

checks.scope: Residual trace notation used in both R16 deletion contradictions
checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-outer-deletion-exclusion.md, Complete-link model and residual traces through Singleton capacities, and LOW15-R15-hub-deletion-exclusion.md, Residual hub traces and actual anchors; compared with manuscript Sections 3 and 6.
checks.observation: The manuscript's s[i], p[i,j], t[i], q and S/P/T totals count the same exact residual K-traces as the sources. The outer proof charges 23 star hub incidences, leaving 37; the hub-deletion proof charges 21, leaving 39, and uses only the three surviving actual anchors. The revised definitions retain residual members avoiding K and arbitrary exterior completions.

checks.scope: Theorem 2 obligation map and support-to-tree transition
checks.method: Read R15-degree2-independent-ordinary-check.md, Ordinary motifs, Whole-completion exterior bound and Eleven-point support; compared with R15-rho6-finite-closure.md, Literal mathematical target and Fresh exact producer and independent replay.
checks.observation: The mapped ordinary note explicitly supplies the degree-one argument and derives the whole-completion budget of three new points before support at most 11. The tree assembly then separates the degree-6 two-triangle root from the two degree-5 roots and uses all 120 root-avoiding triples. The map accurately identifies these as separate obligations and points to the later completed-evidence note. No motif enumeration or tree replay was rerun.

checks.method: Read D16-fibre-independent-preparation.md, Current ordinary interface, Exact down-set inequality and Different star enumeration, against the new map and the complete degree16 assembly.
checks.observation: The mapped preparation document states actual degree16 existence as a premise, distinguishes weighted cone counts from occupied-coordinate masks, and explains how the first occupied edge partitions nonindependent vectors. Its historical unexecuted status is not represented as execution evidence: the map separately names the four completed receipts and complete assembly. This source routing is sufficiently explicit for readers to distinguish proof, algorithm and recorded execution.

checks.scope: Cap15 cover-domain mapping and historical-domain differences
checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md, Every rho8 degree15 link, Exact ordinary criterion for a Q8 leaf gluing, and Arbitrary-support covers; compared with manuscript Section 6 and the map's direct-Jin replacement note.
checks.observation: The older bridge describes an enlarged 29-link domain including both P8 types; the manuscript explicitly removes the already-excluded P8 intersection-1 type and therefore uses 8 plus 13 links. The bridge proves the leaf criterion and arbitrary-support upper bound through support three-covers and pure four-covers. The map explicitly supersedes the older initial k=4 image route with the named direct k=3 add-on, without presenting the earlier text as newly rewritten evidence.
